name: suggestionbox
short: MCP feedback server for reporting errors/improvements, per-agent gated.
description: Runs an MCP tools server (report_error, suggest_improvement) that posts to a bot-owner-configured Discord channel. Registers into corridor's AgentToolServerRegistry so a registered A2A agent's own tool loop (architect today) can call the same tools, gated per agent by a Components V2 toggle panel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about Discord users. It stores a bot-owner-configured feedback channel, MCP listener host/port, and a per-agent access list.
install_msg: Requires corridor (auto-loaded). Configure the feedback channel with [p]suggestionbox channel #channel and the MCP listener with [p]suggestionbox mcp host/port (both bot owner). Grant a registered A2A agent access to these tools via [p]suggestionbox agents.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
